references.text: Gad was allotted land east of the Jordan, as mentioned in this text about the distribution of the land to the tribe of Gad.
Moses gave the tribe of Gad territories that connect with Gad's inheritance and the hidden portion set aside for the lawgiver.
The description of the tribe of Gad's inheritance and their territories east of the Jordan.
The distribution of the land to Gad and Reuben, which connects with Gad's right as the firstborn to the best part of the land.
Jacob's blessing over Gad, which provides background for the blessing of the tribe of Gad in Deuteronomy.
The Lord's righteousness and judgments, which correspond to the expression 'He executed the Lord's righteousness, and his judgments with Israel'.
Righteousness from the Lord, which is linked to the expression that Gad carried out the Lord's righteousness.
The Lord's righteous acts (צִדְקוֹת יְהוָה) are mentioned, which corresponds to צִדְקַת יְהוָה in this verse.
The Lord's righteous deeds are referred to, similar to the description that Gad carried out the Lord's righteousness.
The Lord's righteousness (צִדְקוֹת יְהוָה) is mentioned as a theme that runs throughout Scripture.
